DOF Dry Fire Hydrant Grant Program
Covers 100% of the cost of installing or repairing dry hydrants for Virginia fire departments that secure landowner approval.
50/50 reimbursement grant for PPE, tools and equipment for rural volunteer fire departments; no single item over $5,000 can be funded.
50% cost-share grants up to $10,000 ($20,000 total project) for Wisconsin fire departments with a DNR mutual-aid MOU and county/area fire associations; applications accepted May 1 to July 1.
DSPS Youth Volunteer Firefighter Training Grant
Grants of $500 to $25,000 for DSPS-recognized volunteer or combination fire departments (or partners) to start or expand middle and high school firefighter recruitment and training programs.
MDC Volunteer Fire Assistance Cost-Share Grant
Annual 50% reimbursement grant, up to $3,000, for wildfire-suitable firefighting equipment for fire departments serving communities under 10,000.
DFS Volunteer Fire Protection Association Workers' Compensation Insurance Grant
Up to $2,000 toward workers' compensation insurance premiums for membership-funded Volunteer Fire Protection Associations, paid first come, first served while funds last.
50/50 matching reimbursement grant for wildland fire equipment for Iowa fire departments serving communities of 10,000 or less.
DIAL Local Fire Protection & EMS Providers Grant
State grant funds for Iowa local fire protection and EMS providers that comply with NFIRS or EMS reporting requirements; award amounts set by the director.
State Fire Commission VFD Equipment and Training Grant
Equipment and training grants for recognized West Virginia volunteer fire departments, typically not exceeding $10,000, applied for online through the wvOASIS VSS portal.
FPR Vermont Wildland Fire Gear (VWFG) Grant
50% reimbursement up to $3,000 for wildland fire gear for fire departments and towns serving rural communities of 10,000 or less.
Division of Forests & Lands Volunteer Fire Assistance Grant
50/50 reimbursement grant for approved wildfire equipment for fire suppression organizations in communities under 10,000; applications go to fire chiefs and forest fire wardens each November.

Reimbursement of up to 50% of $10,000 ($5,000 max) for wildland PPE, foam, slip-on units, lighting, pump test gear and radios for fire departments serving communities under 10,000; applications reviewed quarterly.
Equal-share state grants for SC fire departments that are at least 50% volunteer, usable for apparatus, SCBA, PPE, rescue, communications, training and station improvements.
SC Forestry Commission Volunteer Fire Assistance Grant
50/50 matching grant, up to $7,500 per the program page, for wildland firefighting equipment and training for at least 80%-volunteer departments serving rural communities of 10,000 or fewer.
DNR Volunteer Fire Assistance Matching Grant
50/50 grant, maximum $5,000, for prevention materials, training gear, water handling, communications, dry hydrants, Class A foam and safety gear for rural fire departments serving 10,000 or less.
Fire and Public Safety Academy Local Training Support Grant

State-funded grants capped at $10,000 for upkeep and repair of training structures, props and equipment, for fire departments that own training centers in the state's Hub-and-Spoke program or teach Academy courses.
